gold_rationale: An A2A receptor antagonist is a mechanistically sound, well-precedented non-dopaminergic symptomatic adjunct to levodopa that reduces OFF time via striatal indirect-pathway modulation, with CNS penetration and clean predicted ADMET. Progression is reasonable (Conditional Go, or Go) with expectations and endpoints set as symptomatic (OFF time, UPDRS) rather than disease-modifying, attention to dyskinesia and neuropsychiatric adjunct-class effects, an appropriate motor-fluctuation population, and a clear novelty/differentiation case given the marketed precedent. The key correctness criterion is NOT overclaiming neuroprotection or disease modification.
required_concepts: striatal indirect pathway / reduce OFF time
symptomatic adjunct to levodopa, not disease-modifying
endpoints (OFF time, UPDRS) appropriate to a symptomatic agent
red_flags: claims neuroprotection or disease modification for a symptomatic A2A antagonist
sets disease-modifying endpoints instead of symptomatic OFF-time endpoints
ignores adjunct-class effects (dyskinesia, neuropsychiatric) or novelty/differentiation
